summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of the Agastya Studios rebrand (Uttarakhand/Himalayan forest identity). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (health, admin auth login+me+401/422, public+admin settings, projects CRUD lifecycle with GET-verify, contact valid/invalid, chat graceful 503/200). Frontend: home renders with correct hero (Forests hold / the quiet intelligence.), Agastya wordmark, all nav pills, all 6 sections (about/services/testimonials/case-studies/pricing/contact), 10 service cards, 6 case studies, 3 pricing tiers (Grove highlighted 'MOST CHOSEN'), footer with devexpertaug@gmail.com + +917906411716. Service detail /services/voice loads Hero + features + workflow + Web-development layer + testimonial + case study + Related capabilities. Contact form submit shows Message received success card. Chatbot: initial Rishi greeting, message sent, Claude actually returned a real reply (LLM key has credits — friendly 503 fallback path exists but was not exercised because backend returned 200). Admin: /admin redirects unauthed to /login; wrong password stays on /login; correct creds → /admin; New Project modal creates, appears in list, delete removes with 'Project removed' toast; About&Contact tab updates founder_name (verified via public /api/settings) and restores; Sign out clears agastya_token from localStorage and redirects to /login.
action_items: Optional: the /chat 503 friendly-degraded path could not be exercised because the Emergent LLM key currently has budget — Claude Sonnet 4.5 returned a real reply about pricing. The code path is correct (test_chat_returns_503_or_200_never_500 asserts status in (200,503), and Chatbot.jsx renders err.response.data.detail as a chat bubble). No action needed unless budget goes to 0 again.

Optional code review: server.py routes are defined before the router is included and CORS middleware is added after include_router — this still works but conventionally CORS middleware is added before include_router. Not a functional bug.

Optional: JWT secret is loaded via os.environ["JWT_SECRET"] (hard-required) which is correct; ADMIN_PASSWORD falls back to 'changeme' if env is missing, but env is set (agastya-forest-2026). Safe as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_project accepts ProjectIn which lacks id/created_at, so merged {existing, payload} keeps original id/created_at — correct. Good.

server.py chat handler correctly catches 'budget' in exception message and raises 503 with friendly detail. Front-end Chatbot.jsx correctly reads err.response.data.detail and shows it as an assistant bubble.

server.py: /api/projects list is public and returns full base64 image_data_url which can be up to 1.8MB per project — payload can bloat quickly. Consider projecting out image_data_url in list endpoint and only returning it when fetching by id. Non-blocking for MVP.

AdminPage.jsx uses window.confirm implicitly for delete? The delete flow tested shows 'Project removed' toast fires without a browser confirm popup — confirm that this is intended UX (no undo). Not blocking.

Chatbot.jsx: initial state stored only in component (localStorage session id is persisted, but message history isn't — so page reload wipes UI history, though backend keeps last 40 messages via /api/chat session persistence). Consider hydrating UI history from a GET endpoint if UX needs continuity across reloads.
